description: This file defines the SignatureInterface in the AWS SDK for PHP, outlining methods for signing requests with AWS signature protocols and creating pre-signed requests.

classes.name: SignatureInterface
classes.description: Interface specifying methods for signing AWS requests and generating pre-signed URLs.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an HTTP request using AWS signature protocols with provided credentials.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Creates a pre-signed URL/request that expires after a specified time.
